Corollary
[Scalar curvature along steady-soliton flow lines] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0173 ↗ thm:chow-iii-kappa-scaled-derivative-estimates 1. ch20:20.23\group Derivative Applications

Let a nonflat steady gradient Ricci soliton have $\Rm \ge 0$ and be $\kappa $-noncollapsed at all scales. If $\dot\sigma =- abla f$, then \[ R(\sigma (u))\ge rac1{R(\sigma (0))^{-1}+\eta u}. \] In dimension three this implies $R(x)\ge c/(1+d(x,p))$.
Proof

\sketch The soliton satisfies trace Harnack, and Theorem 4 gives $\langle abla R, abla f angle \le \eta R^2$. Therefore $ rac d{du}R(\sigma (u))^{-1}\le \eta $, which integrates to the result.

□
